acceptance: The build floor computes the worktree change set against its base once per floor run, and comment_floor and the history floor both read that one value.
A test shows git is asked for the diff once when both floors run.
fix: Compute the diff-based change set once per build-floor run and share it between the diff-based floors.
summary: With the comment-history floor added, commentFloorFailures and historyFloorFailures each walk the worktree diff against its base once per build-floor run. A third diff-based floor would add a third walk.
title: The build floor computes its diff change set once for all diff-based floors
